title: Account for contributed property, plant, and equipment

items.concept: Initial recognition of unconditional contributed land and building at FV net of transfer costs; subsequent SL depreciation schedule and period-end adjusting JE
Number-variant twin: lump-sum appraisal allocation to land/building, contribution revenue net of costs, subsequent depreciation
Donor-imposed condition (defer then recognize contribution revenue); disposal of previously contributed PPE with period-end dep update
Classification of contribution vs exchange; measurement of contribution revenue when recipient pays cash
